name: speakeasy
description: Give Codex and ChatGPT Work a controllable voice through the native SpeakEasy menu-bar player.

interface.shortDescription: A controllable voice for your agents
interface.longDescription: Generate narration with local or configured speech providers, then listen through a permanent native macOS player with autoplay, queueing, transport controls, playback speed, volume, a word-synced HUD, and one-click return to the originating Codex task.
defaultPrompt: Read this summary aloud in SpeakEasy.
Queue a spoken update and autoplay it.
Show the current SpeakEasy player status.
